newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices firm helped by low supply.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices firm helped by low supply.

text.p: Indian sugar prices held steady on Wednesday with consumer and retail demand low but restricted supplies halted any slide, dealers said.
"Mill supplies remained low due to poor availability of trucks to carry sugar at the producing centres," one broker said. "Truck owners are demanding higher tariffs."

Ready delivery sugar S-30 was quiet at 1,237/1,265 rupees and M-30 at 1,265/1,318 rupees. Sugar mill delivery however fell by five rupees to 1,165/1,175 rupees on sluggish outstation demand at mill level.
